question: After whitening covariance in eigenspace and rotating back into the native token/feature basis, can an explicit per-token SNR schedule and matched loss allocation restore a useful image-like resolving hierarchy?

correction.previous_transform: PCA coordinates: (x - mean) @ U @ diag(gain); gamma zero remained a sequence/channel rotation
correction.intended_transform: symmetric/ZCA coordinates: mean + (x - mean) @ U @ diag(gain) @ U.T; gamma zero is the exact native identity
correction.interpretation: The completed power-whitening screen diagnoses the cost of exposing global sequence modes as literal tokens. It does not test rotate-back whitening.

source.external_control: native v27 common/uniform prior seed 1 at FID/KID 26.7430/0.017538 (5k) and 24.5341/0.017647 (10k)

analysis.gain_formula: (eigenvalue / mean_eigenvalue)^(-gamma/2), without an extra common scale; later tensor-wide cache normalization removes common scale and gamma zero stays exactly identity

variants.channel: apply channel ZCA identically within every native token; never mix tokens
variants.sequence: apply sequence ZCA and rotate back; output slots retain native labels but contain symmetric cross-token mixing
variants.axial: apply sequence and channel ZCA together using the Kronecker eigenbasis

measurements: complete heldout covariance rank and residual off-diagonal fraction
sequence, channel, and literal-token effective ranks
fraction of each output token's linear-map energy drawn from its matching native input token
float32, simulated float16-cache, and decoded round-trip error

training_authorization.primary_transform: axial ZCA at gamma 1 if every numeric gate passes; this is the direct test of removing the channel and sequence magnitude spectra before restoring a token hierarchy
training_authorization.fallback: channel-only ZCA at gamma 1 only if axial ZCA fails a numerical gate; flattened ZCA is analysis-only because it maximally mixes token-feature coordinates
training_authorization.reason_not_to_select_by_rank: covariance rank and whitening strength are diagnostics, not latent-quality selectors

token_intervention.ordering: native token index, no PCA-coordinate exposure and no post-hoc permutation
token_intervention.source_profile: six CIFAR radial-band population powers, tempered with beta 0.25
token_intervention.weight_formula: mean-one over all 64 tokens of 1 + original_CIFAR_band_power^0.25
token_intervention.clean_magnitude: no explicit per-token rescaling; ZCA output receives only the existing tensor-wide population normalization

arms: ordered token time / tempered token loss
factorial_if_authorized.recipe: prior seed 1, width 512, depth 12, eight heads, QK RMS normalization, batch 256, 60000 optimizer steps, learning rate 1e-4, 1000 warmup, 50-step Heun evaluation seed 54321
factorial_if_authorized.selection: decoded FID/KID at 5000 samples; advance improvements, arms within two FID, and FID/KID disagreements to 10000; flow loss and whitening diagnostics do not select
factorial_if_authorized.interaction_goal: distinguish the cost of ZCA, the value of token timing after ZCA, the value of restored implicit loss allocation, and whether timing plus weighting is complementary or double-counted

gpu_protocol: /workspace/GPU_QUEUEING.md; analysis, cache construction, training, and evaluation use lifetime gpu-claim locks under supervisor
